title: Zeeman/Bethe Citadel -- dynamic thermodynamic firewall
gate_source: EXP-508 static Citadel -> couple E* to Zeeman energy + Bethe level density (living ecology)
operator: engine.validity.bethe_citadel_509 + is_bethe_citadel_509; observable + opt-in gate in dentatus.api

law.dS_cit_bethe: H_in - H_out >= 0  : a world too complex for its excitation 'overheats' and is rejected

level_density_parameter.a: a0 * d_stalk  (d_stalk = 18 = stalk-schema mass = substrate degrees of freedom)
level_density_parameter.decision: a is a SUBSTRATE property, FIXED per realization -- it does NOT scale with leaf-count
level_density_parameter.rationale: leaf-count is the realized complexity already in H_out; coupling a to it double-counts N and dissolves the excitation friction (H_in ~ sqrt(N*E) would grow faster than H_out ~ log2 N)

firewall_role.default: OBSERVABLE only -- bethe_citadel reported as the temperature; H_verified gated by manifold AND static-508
firewall_role.opt_in: request bethe_gate=True -> triple firewall: manifold AND citadel-508 AND bethe-509
firewall_role.safety: a calibration constant never silently flips H_verified; valid worlds verified Bethe-admissible (margin >= +0.86)

assertions_fork_A: [2] Bethe math: H_in = 2*sqrt(a*E*)/ln2, a = a0*d_stalk, dS_cit = H_in - H_out
[3] a = substrate schema mass (a0*d_stalk, d=18); independent of leaf-count (no double-count)
[4] excitation friction: fixed complexity, decreasing E* -> dS decreases and crosses 0 (overheat threshold)
[5] overheat reject: low-excitation over-complex world -> dS < 0 -> is_bethe_citadel False
[6] valid worlds admitted: docking-bay ladder all Bethe-admissible (E* = realized beta_Z)
[7] observable always reported: api returns bethe_citadel block (E_star, H_in, H_out, dS_cit)
[8] opt-in gate: bethe_gate=True adds the constraint; default leaves H_verified unchanged
[10] no regression: default H_verified for the docking bay unchanged vs EXP-508
assertions_fork_B: [2] E_star (beta_Z) fwd == mir (Zeeman energy is norm-derived, P_yz-invariant)

exp510_gate.trigger: thermodynamic firewall stable -> multi-velocity moving sections (Ghost #40)
